title: ApptBundlePolicy - Data API
description: Policy that defines how the bundling of service appointments should be handled. This object is available in API version 54.0 and later.

BundleEndTimeFieldName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BundleEndTimeFieldName.description: If IsTimeCalcByBundleDurationField is true, this field represents the name of the field used for entering the end time of the bundle.

BundleStartTimeFieldName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BundleStartTimeFieldName.description: If IsTimeCalcByBundleDurationField is true, this field represents the name of the field used for entering the start time of the bundle.

CanAllowSchleDepndInBundle.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanAllowSchleDepndInBundle.description: This field is reserved for future use.

ConstantTimeValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ConstantTimeValue.description: If IsTimeCalcByBundleDurationField is true, this field represents the total time of the bundle as a preset constant value.

FilterCriteriaId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FilterCriteriaId.description: The active recordset filter criteria used for the bundle members. Only service appointments that meet the criteria can be bundled. This is a relationship field.

IsAutomaticBundling.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsAutomaticBundling.description: Indicates if the policy is relevant for automatic bundling.

IsManualBundling.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsManualBundling.description: Indicates if the policy is relevant for manual bundling. The default value is ‘false’.

IsTimeCalcByBundleDurationFld.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsTimeCalcByBundleDurationFld.description: Indicates if the bundle’s duration is validated. If true, the bundle’s start time is subtracted from the bundle’s end time. If the result is a negative value, it uses ConstantTimeValue as the bundle’s duration. The default value is ‘false’.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

LimitAmountOfBundleMembers.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LimitAmountOfBundleMembers.description: The maximum number of bundle members that can be included in a bundle.

LimitDurationOfBundle.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LimitDurationOfBundle.description: The maximum duration of a bundle.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of this object. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

Priority.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Priority.description: The priority level that this bundle policy should be given when the bundle policies are analyzed using the automatic mode.
